lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple parallel horizontal rows of discrete high-luminance circular spots located posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots to create a rectilinear grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal linear ridge running along the upper third of the lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from highlight to shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small high-luminance pixel clusters visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin silhouette.
